question: Where are Teide National Park and Garajonay National Park located?

steps.answer: Canary Islands, Spain. Specifically, Teide National Park is in Tenerife, and Garajonay National Park is in La Gomera.

citations.claim: Teide National Park is located in Tenerife (Canary Islands, Spain)
Garajonay National Park is located on the island of La Gomera, one of the Canary Islands (Spain)
